## Changeset / release

- Code or API changes: run `pnpm changeset` and commit `.changeset/*.md`.
- Docs / README / LICENSE only: no changeset needed (paths under `docs/`, root `*.md`, etc.).
- Other cases without release: add label **`no-changeset`**.
